title: CRITICAL: fix orphan field_tags schema causing cron failures
description:
**Elke cron-run** gooit een `FieldException` op prod + lokaal:

> Field 'field_tags' on entity type 'node' references a target entity type 'taxonomy_term' which does not exist.

Taxonomy module is NIET enabled (ooit uninstalled zonder cleanup), maar de field schema definitie staat nog in key_value:

- collection: `entity.storage_schema.sql`
- name: `node.field_schema_data.field_tags`

Fix (lokaal + prod):
```
drush ev "\Drupal::keyValue('entity.storage_schema.sql')->delete('node.field_schema_data.field_tags');" && drush cr
```

Check ook `entity.definitions.installed`, `entity.last_installed_schema`, en `core.base_field_override.*field_tags*` voor andere refs:
```
drush sqlq "SELECT collection, name FROM key_value WHERE name LIKE '%field_tags%'"
```

Verifieer: `drush core:cron` draait zonder error.
close_reason:
Root cause: 3 orphan deleted-field entries in state collection (field_tags→taxonomy_term uninstalled; comment_body→comment uninstalled; field_image→file still valid). FieldPurger::purgeBatch() crashte op field_tags omdat EntityReferenceItem::schema() de missende target entity type niet kan resolven.

Fix: mac_tools_deploy_purge_orphan_deleted_fields_v3 — scant beide state entries (field.storage.deleted + field.field.deleted) en drop orphans wiens host of target entity type weg is, EN fields wiens storage al eerder was weggegooid. Idempotent + traceerbaar in git.

Development: v1 miste de 'orphan field waarvan storage al weg is' case; v2 implementeerde dat partial; v3 doet beide gevallen correct. Elke rename-bump forceert re-run (drush deploy:hook tracks by name).

Pipeline 40591347725 ✓. Prod verified: storage=0 field=0, 3 opeenvolgende cron run completed zonder error.

title: Set READ-COMMITTED isolation on prod (settings.php)

Zet in `web/sites/default/settings.php` (of prod-specifieke include):

```php
$databases['default']['default']['init_commands']['isolation'] = "SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED";
```

title: Investigate 'page not found' flood from recursive crawler URLs
description:
The dblog is flooded with "page not found" entries. Example: https://metalartcreations.ddev.site/admin/reports/dblog/event/1299662

## Stats (watchdog snapshot)
- 2694 total 'page not found' entries (vs. only 1 'access denied' and 1 'cron' warning+)
- 2675 (~99%) contain 'www.metalartcreations.nl' embedded in the path
- 431 end with '/creatieve-workshops.html'
- All from bot IPs: 185.191.171.* (SemrushBot) and 85.208.96.* (another SEO crawler)
- No referer recorded (bots stripped)

## Pattern
Recursive paths with '/workshops-cursussen/' and 'www.metalartcreations.nl/workshops-cursussen/' segments stacked many times, e.g.

/workshops-cursussen/workshops-cursussen/workshops-cursussen/www.metalartcreations.nl/workshops-cursussen/...

## Likely cause
Somewhere in content/view/block/template on a page under /workshops-cursussen there's a relative link like:
- href="workshops-cursussen/foo" (should start with /)
- href="www.metalartcreations.nl/..." (missing https://)

The crawler follows these, each hit appends to the path, and the server keeps 404'ing — producing an infinite loop.

## To investigate
1. Find source links: grep node bodies, custom blocks, menu items, views for 'workshops-cursussen' / 'www.metalartcreations.nl' with missing scheme or missing leading slash.
2. Check for a redirect that generates these (redirect module).
3. Consider blocking the bots or returning 410 Gone for these paths.
4. Consider lowering dblog retention / excluding 'page not found' from dblog (via honeypot/perimeter module) to stop the flood.
close_reason:
Root cause gevonden: node 34 'Nieuws & Agenda' body bevatte href="www.metalartcreations.nl/workshops-cursussen/workshop-meiden-techniek" (scheme-less → relative). Crawler recursed /path/www.metalartcreations.nl/workshops-cursussen/... en 404-page toonde dezelfde slechte link → infinite loop.

Fixes:
1. Node 34 body: href="www.metalartcreations.nl/" → href="https://www.metalartcreations.nl/" (via mac_tools_deploy_fix_node_34_schemeless_href, idempotent)
2. Perimeter patronen toegevoegd: /.*workshops-cursussen.*workshops-cursussen.*/ en /.*/www\.metalartcreations\.nl/.*/ — crawlers die blijven proberen worden geban'd via ban module
3. Verified op prod: node 34 clean, recursieve URL → 403.

Follow-ups (zie bead afsplitsingen later): 9 nodes met .html suffix hrefs (content cleanup, lagere prio); config_filter composer remove (phase 2).

title: Fix 'Undefined array key "id"' warning in alpaca_preprocess_block()
description:
Prod watchdog toont 4× PHP sev-4 warning:

> Warning: Undefined array key "id"
> alpaca_preprocess_block()
> web/themes/alpaca/alpaca.theme

Code probeert $variables['elements']['#id'] (of $id direct) te lezen zonder isset-check. In D11 is #id niet gegarandeerd aanwezig op elke block render array.

Fix: zoek in alpaca.theme naar array access op 'id' zonder null-safe (??), voeg `$id = $variables['elements']['#id'] ?? NULL;` toe of equivalent patroon.

Reproduceerbaar: welke block triggerde dit? Check $variables['elements']['#plugin_id'] in dezelfde functie om context te krijgen bij de warning.

Lokaal reproduceren: bekijk een node-detail pagina terwijl $config['system.logging']['error_level'] op 'verbose' staat.
close_reason: web/themes/alpaca/alpaca.theme line 42: $variables['content']['#attributes']['block'] = $variables['attributes']['id'] gewrapt in isset-guard. Pipeline 40592128913 ✓. Live-geverifieerd: na deploy en hit op home + /workshops-cursussen zijn er 0 nieuwe alpaca_preprocess_block warnings in watchdog (was 4× voor fix).

title: Enable config_readonly for prod (or uninstall)
description:
`drupal/config_readonly ^1.0@beta` is in composer.json, maar het module is NIET enabled en er is geen `\$settings['config_readonly']` flag in settings.php. Dead weight.

**Twee opties**:

**Enable + configureer** (aanbevolen):
1. `drush en config_readonly -y && drush cex`
2. Voeg aan prod settings-override toe: `\$settings['config_readonly'] = TRUE;`
3. Lokaal/dev leeg laten (FALSE/weg) zodat je nog kunt experimenteren
4. Resultaat: config changes op prod kunnen alleen via git deploy, niet via admin UI
5. Blokkeert de "iemand wijzigt een block via admin, deploy overschrijft" footgun

**Of uninstall + composer remove**:
Als config-via-admin-op-prod echt moet kunnen (bv. voor birgit/webmaster), is config_readonly contra-productief. Verwijder dan uit composer.

Keuze overlaten aan Boris.

title: Fix honeypot schema mismatch (installed 8102 < last_removed 8104)
description:
`drush updatedb` meldt tijdens core 11.4.11 update:
> The installed version of the Honeypot module is too old to update. Update to an intermediate version first (last removed version: 8104, installed version: 8102).

Oorzaak: honeypot 2.2.x heeft `hook_update_last_removed() returns 8104` (zie web/modules/contrib/honeypot/honeypot.install:76). Onze schema staat op 8102. Dus de update van 8102 → 8104 moet via een eerdere honeypot release gebeuren waar updates 8103/8104 nog in zitten.

Fix:
1. `ddev composer require 'drupal/honeypot:^2.1' --with-all-dependencies`
2. `ddev drush updatedb -y` (laat updates 8103, 8104 lopen)
3. `ddev composer require 'drupal/honeypot:^2.2' --with-all-dependencies`
4. `ddev drush updatedb -y` (zou nu geen honeypot-fouten geven)
5. `ddev drush cex -y` + `ddev drush cr`
6. Verifieer: `ddev drush ev "echo \Drupal::keyValue('system.schema')->get('honeypot');"` ≥ 8104

Prod krijgt dezelfde treatment via `@self.live` of lokaal + deploy.

Pre-existing issue (niet door core-update veroorzaakt).
close_reason: Lokaal gefixt: hostname index toegevoegd op honeypot_user table + schema bumped naar 8104 (via drush ev + honeypot_schema() spec). Composer downgrade naar ^2.1 bleek niet mogelijk (2.1.x vereist Drupal 9/10). Removed updates 8103 (hostname index) + 8104 (Tour cache clear - Tour niet enabled hier) manueel afgehandeld. Prod-command op klembord gezet. drush updatedb geeft geen honeypot error meer.

title: Cleanup orphan system.schema entry for color module (prod)
description:
Lokaal + prod: key_value row `system.schema/color` (value 8000) is achtergebleven na removal van core color module in D11. Watchdog logt elke requirements-check een notice: 'Module color has an entry in the system.schema key/value storage, but is missing from your site'.

Fix (op klembord geweest):
```
drush @self.live ev "\Drupal::keyValue('system.schema')->delete('color');" && drush @self.live cr
```

Lokaal:
```
ddev drush ev "\Drupal::keyValue('system.schema')->delete('color');" && ddev drush cr
```

Geen config dependencies op color (gecheckt). Alleen de key_value regel wissen.

Zie ook: https://www.drupal.org/node/3137656
close_reason: Lokaal uitgevoerd: drush ev deleted system.schema/color key_value entry + cr. Status report notice weg. Prod-command staat in bead/op klembord — Boris draait die zelf na deploy.

title: Composer audit: review abandoned package oomphinc/composer-installers-extender
description:
Ran `composer audit`:

- Security advisories: **0** (clean)
- Abandoned packages: **1**
  - `oomphinc/composer-installers-extender` — no suggested replacement

## Context
This package was traditionally used to extend `composer/installers` so additional package types (e.g. drupal-asset-library, drupal-vendor) could be routed to custom install paths. Composer/installers 2.x covers most of this natively now.

## To do
1. Check if composer.json still relies on it (grep root composer.json and composer.lock for 'oomphinc' and for the 'installer-types' extra config).
2. If still needed: pin / monitor upstream for replacement guidance (project is archived upstream).
3. If obsolete: remove the require entry and the 'extra.installer-types' block if any, run composer update, test install paths of drupal-library and other custom types.

## Follow-up
Re-run `ddev exec composer audit` after any contrib/core update to catch new advisories early. Consider adding this to the site-hygiene checklist / CI.
close_reason: Removed oomphinc/composer-installers-extender (abandoned, not needed - no installer-types in extra, all installer-paths use standard composer/installers 2.x types). Also cleaned up harvesthq/chosen library + its custom repositories entry (leftover from chosen cleanup). Pipeline 40586697632 ✓. composer audit now 100%% clean: no advisories, no abandoned packages.

title: Content cleanup: fix .html suffix hrefs in 9 nodes
description:

Aanpak:
1. Query: `SELECT entity_id FROM node__body WHERE body_value RLIKE 'href="[^"]*\\.html"'`
2. Per node body: strip `.html` suffix uit relative hrefs, controleer alias nog bestaat
3. Voorzichtig met externe links (die mogen .html houden)
4. Script in mac_tools.deploy.php zodat prod via drush deploy mee gaat.

title: Migrate contact module forms to webform (contact → webform)
description:
Site gebruikt core/contrib `contact` module met het 'feedback' form (recipient: birgitdoesborg@gmail.com). 56 contact_message rijen in de database.

Core contact is in D11.3 verhuisd naar contrib (`drupal/contact 1.x`). Werkt, maar is beperkt. Webform is standaard, flexibeler, en integreert beter met honeypot (al enabled) en andere spam-protection.

Gefaseerd migratiepad (zie drupal-site-hygiene §8):
1. `composer require drupal/webform` + `drush en webform webform_ui -y`
2. Bouw webform-equivalent van 'feedback' (fields, email handler, access, flood)
3. Menu/link/block refs van /contact → nieuwe webform-pad
4. Spam-protection op het webform vóór go-live
5. Port custom alters (hook_form_alter, honeypot-vragen)
6. Uninstall + composer remove drupal/contact + contact_storage (aparte phase)
7. Locale cleanup voor contact

Lage prio — contact werkt nog. Doen bij volgende grote content-sprint.
